About ColorVerse

Choose with context.

ColorVerse is a focused place to explore color, compare directions, and make a palette useful before it reaches a project.

The idea

Color is a decision, not a swatch.

The library gives you a visual starting point. The atlas lets you play with individual colors. The studio shows whether the relationship still works when it becomes a page, a slide, a post, or a shop.

Image privacy

Your image stays with you.

Image analysis happens locally in your browser. ColorVerse does not upload or store the image you choose. The extracted palette is kept only in this browser session so you can take it into the studio.

Current scope

A small, useful first version.

Today the product is intentionally simple: curated five-color studies, three image readings, a living color atlas, and lightweight exports. The focus is a clear path from curiosity to a usable direction.
